BrochureContent.Content:
Hume Auctioneers ? We Get The Pick Of The Crop.

Set on a magnificent 0.6-acre site, this exceptional detached residence enjoys a magnificently peaceful position along a quiet country lane just outside the village, offering the perfect balance of privacy and convenience. Approached through an impressive formal gated entrance, the property immediately creates a striking first impression. A sweeping driveway leads through beautifully maintained front lawns to a stunning home of immense character and charm, enjoying dramatic kerb appeal from every angle. 

To the rear, a generous private garden provides the ideal setting for family life and outdoor entertaining, while the surrounding countryside offers breathtaking panoramic views and a wonderful sense of tranquillity. Combining a beautiful setting, outstanding presentation, and an enviable rural outlook, this is a truly special home in an idyllic location.

Step inside to discover a beautifully presented and exceptionally bright interior, designed to maximise both comfort and natural light. The welcoming entrance hall leads to a spacious living room featuring a striking fireplace, creating a warm and inviting focal point for family living and entertaining. A second reception room to the front of the house is beautiful bright and airy with a feature fireplace and panoramic windows. This room can double as a large playroom or home office.

At the heart of the home is an impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area, finished with contemporary fitted cabinetry, generous worktop space and ample room for a family-sized dining table. Large windows flood the space with natural light while offering attractive views of the surrounding countryside. The adjoining sunroom provides an additional reception area, with vaulted ceilings and extensive glazing creating a peaceful space to relax and enjoy the outdoor setting throughout the year.

The ground floor is further complemented by a large family bathroom, finished in a timeless neutral palette and featuring both a separate shower and corner bath. A practical utility room provides additional storage and laundry facilities.

Upstairs, the accommodation comprises four generously proportioned double bedrooms, all presented in excellent condition and benefiting from bright, airy interiors. Three of the bedrooms one and two enjoy the added convenience of independent ensuite shower rooms, whilst bedrooms three and four share a superb Jack & Jill ensuite. making the property ideally suited to modern family living.

Throughout the home, neutral décor, quality flooring and large windows combine to create a fresh, contemporary feel, while the well-balanced layout offers excellent flexibility for growing families. The property has been meticulously maintained and is presented in turnkey condition, ready for immediate occupation.

The property has an exceptional energy system enjoying a superb 22 panel solar system including battery backup, oil fired burner and a back boiler off the reception room inset stove. All pf the bathrooms have electric underfloor heating. Together with the highest level of insulation, this all combines to an amazing A rated BER certificate.

Outside there is a detached two storey building complete with it?s own central heating system. With a bathroom, 2 upstairs rooms and a superb open plan downstairs layout, this property is ideal for a multiplicity of uses. 

Situated in the picturesque village of Shanahoe, this property offers the perfect balance of peaceful countryside living and generous private living space. Ideally located just 8 km west of the heritage town of Abbeyleix and 7 km south of Mountrath, it provides both tranquillity and convenience. The property is within a 20-minute drive of Portlaoise and just 3 minutes from Scoil Fionntán Naofa and the local church, making it an ideal choice for families and those seeking a welcoming village community while remaining close to essential amenities and transport links.
